[attribute-symbol]
=== `@symbol` Symbol

Stores the symbol (for example, an asterisk, numeral, section mark) that was displayed in the original document to identify a specific footnote, if this symbol is to be preserved.

#### Usage/Remarks
In NISO STS, this attribute is used only on footnotes and collaborations. This is expected to be uncommon in standards documents.

#### OPTIONAL on elements:  <<element-collab,`<collab>`>>, 
                  <<element-fn,`<fn>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The symbol, such as a dagger
                        “†”, used to mark a footnote or inclusion in a collaboration.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
